input.issue:
Error occured in tensor_contract
### Bug Description

When attempting to discard the last system in a superoperator, an error occurs if the system sizes are unequal. I think this issue may be caused by an incorrect contraction of dimensions.

### Code to Reproduce the Bug

```shell
from qutip import *
A = qeye([[1], [1, 3]])
tensor_contract(A, (2, 5))
```


### Code Output

```shell
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "from qutip import *.py", line 4, in <module>
    tensor_contract(A, (2, 5))
  File "/opt/anaconda3/envs/qutip/lib/python3.12/site-packages/qutip/core/tensor.py", line 341, in tensor_contract
    qmtx = qtens.reshape((l_mtx_dims, r_mtx_dims))
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 9 into shape (1,1)
```


### Expected Behaviour

It should output a matrix with a shape (1, 1) instead of size 9.
